//: The abilities screen (08 §5, 12 §10.7): the character's abilities as `view.ability_uses` gives them, one row for each use, with its rank, what it costs, whether it is ready, cooling down or dormant, and the quick slot it is on; and the modes of its abilities (`view.ability_modes`), each on or off. Enter on a use closes the screen and uses it: its parameters are asked for with the pickers, but for those the ability's grant supplies, and the command is `use_ability`; one that cannot be used now is refused with its reason. Enter on a mode switches it (`set_mode`). A number key puts the use selected on that quick slot: the slots are preferences, kept with the player's other choices between runs, and the same number key in play uses it. The `core` mod's powers come from the template or trait `power_sampler`.
title: Abilities

columns.title: Use
columns.value: {if it.available then it.label else ''}<dim>{if it.available then '' else it.label}</>

columns.title: Key
columns.value: {(if app.pref('slot_1') == it.id then '1 ' else '') + (if app.pref('slot_2') == it.id then '2 ' else '') + (if app.pref('slot_3') == it.id then '3 ' else '') + (if app.pref('slot_4') == it.id then '4 ' else '') + (if app.pref('slot_5') == it.id then '5 ' else '') + (if app.pref('slot_6') == it.id then '6 ' else '') + (if app.pref('slot_7') == it.id then '7 ' else '') + (if app.pref('slot_8') == it.id then '8 ' else '') + (if app.pref('slot_9') == it.id then '9 ' else '')}

table.tip: Enter uses it; 1 to 9 put it on a quick slot.

list.item: {if it.on then '[on] ' else '[  ] '}{it.name}: {it.label}<dim>{if it.available then '' else '  ' + it.why}</>
list.tip: Enter switches it on or off.

tooltip.value: Tab moves between the lists, Enter uses, 1 to 9 put on a key, Esc goes back.
